title: Protected KVM on Arm64: A Technical Deep Dive - Quentin Perret, Google
summary: Quentin Perret of Google gives a technical deep dive into protected KVM (pKVM) on Arm64, a confidential computing approach for CPUs without hardware extensions. It explains how the nVHE hypervisor manages stage-2 MMU access control to protect guest memory.
why: Used as a primary source for pKVM architecture in threads on Android virtualization and isolated VMs.

quote.text: A modern virtualization architecture can be found in the OSS pKVM L0 nested hypervisor for Android Virtualization Framework
